intent: Updated sensor size to 0.012, body length to 0.22, and body width to 0.16 to improve line tracking and reduce line loss events.
rationale: The telemetry indicates that the robot experienced 5 line loss events during the last trial, which is still high. To address this, I am adjusting the sensor size to 0.012, which is expected to improve the robot's ability to detect the line more effectively. Additionally, I am modifying the body length to 0.22 and the body width to 0.16 to enhance stability and tracking performance. These changes are based on the feedback that previous adjustments helped but further tuning is necessary. I expect these modifications to reduce line loss events in future trials.
